data.exact_reserve_text: An adverse run off deviation of GBP 1.5m (2017: favourable run off deviation of GBP 0.8m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012, 2013, 2014 and 2015 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003 and the Legacy Catlin Group entities.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reserve movements on Whole Account Quota Share contracts
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse run-off deviation of GBP 1.5m experienced in respect of reserve movements on the 2012-2015 years of account for Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003 and Legacy Catlin Group entities.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2088 recorded an adverse prior year reserve development of GBP 1.5m in 2018, driven by adverse claims development on Whole Account Quota Share contracts relating to the 2012-2015 years of account (Syndicate 2003 and legacy Catlin entities). This represents a modest strengthening of reserves (approximately 0.87% of the opening gross claims outstanding).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative. Prior year development taken from Note 6 ('Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding') which states an adverse run-off deviation of GBP 1.5m (treated as gross and used directly). Gross claims development triangle is available (gross) and was not used as the primary source because the note 6 narrative explicitly quantifies the prior year movement. No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior years are listed besides Whole Account Quota Share reserve movements. LOB mapping of the PYD to 'Treaty' is an inferred mapping since the movement is described as arising from Whole Account Quota Share contracts.
